title: Golden Rice
subtitle: Provitamin A in the rice grain
objective: Reconstruct the carotenoid biosynthesis pathway in rice endosperm to produce beta-carotene (provitamin A).
description: Rice endosperm lacks the carotenoid pathway. By introducing genes from daffodil (psy) and bacteria (crtI), scientists engineered rice to produce beta-carotene in the grain. Your task is to connect the correct genes, enzymes, reactions, and metabolites to complete this pathway.

organism.description: Golden Rice is a transgenic variety of Oryza sativa engineered to express the carotenoid biosynthesis pathway in the endosperm, which normally lacks this pathway. The grain accumulates beta-carotene, giving it a characteristic golden color.
organism.description_es: Variedad transgénica de Oryza sativa que produce betacaroteno en el endospermo, que normalmente no tiene esta ruta. El grano lo acumula y por eso tiene color dorado.

biologicalContext.pathwayDescription: The carotenoid biosynthesis pathway in the rice endosperm plastid converts geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate (GGPP) through a series of enzymatic steps to produce beta-carotene. This requires three key enzymatic activities: phytoene synthase (PSY), phytoene desaturase (crtI, from Erwinia uredovora), and lycopene beta-cyclase (LYC).

nodes.label: psy Gene (Phytoene Synthase)
nodes.description: Phytoene synthase gene from Narcissus pseudonarcissus (daffodil). Encodes the enzyme that catalyzes the first committed step in carotenoid biosynthesis: condensation of two GGPP molecules to form phytoene.
nodes.description_es: Gen de la daffodil (Narcissus pseudonarcissus) que codifica la enzima fitoeno sintasa, primer paso de la ruta de carotenoides.

nodes.label: crtI Gene (Carotene Desaturase)
nodes.description: Carotene desaturase gene from Erwinia uredovora (now Pantoea ananatis). A bacterial gene that performs four desaturation steps in a single enzyme, converting phytoene to lycopene.
nodes.description_es: Gen bacteriano de Pantoea ananatis que codifica la fitoeno desaturasa, realizando 4 pasos de desaturación en un solo enzima.

nodes.label: lyc Gene (Lycopene Cyclase)
nodes.description: Lycopene beta-cyclase gene (endogenous rice gene). Encodes the enzyme that cyclizes lycopene to form alpha- and beta-carotene.
nodes.description_es: Gen endógeno del arroz que codifica la licopeno β-ciclasa, convirtiendo licopeno en beta-caroteno.

metadata.note: Endogenous gene upregulated when lycopene substrate becomes available

nodes.label: Phytoene Synthase (PSY)
nodes.description: The enzyme encoded by the psy gene. Catalyzes the condensation of two GGPP molecules to produce phytoene. This is the rate-limiting step in carotenoid biosynthesis.
nodes.description_es: Enzima que cataliza la condensación de dos moléculas de GGPP para formar fitoeno, el primer carotenoide de la ruta.

nodes.label: Carotene Desaturase (CrtI)
nodes.description: The bacterial enzyme encoded by crtI. A flavoprotein that performs four consecutive desaturation reactions on phytoene, producing lycopene in a single multifunctional enzyme.
nodes.description_es: Enzima bacteriana que realiza cuatro reacciones de desaturación, convirtiendo fitoeno en licopeno.

nodes.label: Lycopene Beta-Cyclase (LYC)
nodes.description: The enzyme encoded by the lyc gene. Catalyzes the cyclization of both ends of the lycopene molecule, converting linear lycopene into cyclic beta-carotene.
nodes.description_es: Enzima que cicla los extremos del licopeno para formar β-caroteno, el precursor de la vitamina A.

nodes.label: GGPP (Geranylgeranyl Pyrophosphate)
nodes.description: Geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate (GGPP) — the universal C20 isoprenoid precursor present in the plastid. Starting substrate for carotenoid biosynthesis.
nodes.description_es: Precursor de 20 carbonos del que parten todos los carotenoides en la célula vegetal.

nodes.label: Phytoene
nodes.description: 15-cis-Phytoene — the first dedicated carotenoid. A colorless C40 carotene formed by condensation of two GGPP molecules.
nodes.description_es: Primer carotenoide de la ruta, incoloro, precursor de todos los carotenoides coloreados.

nodes.label: Lycopene
nodes.description: All-trans-lycopene — a red C40 carotenoid with 11 conjugated double bonds. Immediate precursor to beta-carotene.
nodes.description_es: Carotenoide rojo con 11 dobles enlaces conjugados. Precursor directo del β-caroteno.

nodes.label: Beta-Carotene (Provitamin A)
nodes.description: Beta-carotene — the orange C40 carotenoid with two beta-ionone rings. Provitamin A: cleaved to yield retinal (vitamin A).
nodes.description_es: Carotenoide naranja que el cuerpo humano convierte en vitamina A. El objetivo del Arroz Dorado.

metadata.significance: Provitamin A — cleaved to retinal by human BCO1 enzyme

nodes.label: Phytoene Synthesis
nodes.description: Condensation of 2 × GGPP → phytoene + 2 × pyrophosphate. The first committed step in carotenoid biosynthesis.
nodes.description_es: Reacción de condensación: 2× GGPP → Fitoeno, catalizada por PSY.

nodes.label: Phytoene Desaturation
nodes.description: Four sequential desaturation steps converting phytoene to lycopene, all catalyzed by the bacterial CrtI enzyme.
nodes.description_es: Serie de 4 desaturaciones: Fitoeno → Licopeno, catalizada por CrtI.

nodes.label: Lycopene Cyclization
nodes.description: Cyclization of both ends of lycopene to form beta-carotene. Each cyclization converts a linear end-group into a beta-ionone ring.
nodes.description_es: Ciclación de extremos: Licopeno → β-Caroteno, catalizada por LYC.

nodes.label: Golden Grain
nodes.description: The visible phenotype of Golden Rice: endosperm accumulates beta-carotene, giving the grain a golden-orange color.
nodes.description_es: Fenotipo objetivo: endospermo de arroz con coloración amarilla-naranja por acumulación de β-caroteno.

metadata.nutritional_significance: Addresses vitamin A deficiency in rice-dependent populations

nodes.label: Endosperm Plastid
nodes.description: The amyloplast (plastid) of the rice endosperm. Normally devoid of carotenoid biosynthetic enzymes, it contains the precursor GGPP from the MEP pathway.
nodes.description_es: Orgánulo del endospermo donde se acumula almidón y donde opera la ruta de carotenoides en el Arroz Dorado.

nodes.label: CHLG (Chlorophyll Synthase)
nodes.description: Chlorophyll synthase gene. Encodes an enzyme in the chlorophyll biosynthesis pathway, not the carotenoid pathway.
nodes.description_es: Enzima del cloroplasto que sintetiza clorofila. No participa en la ruta de carotenoides del endospermo.

metadata.distractor_reason: Chlorophyll synthesis is irrelevant to carotenoid pathway in endosperm

nodes.label: Waxy (GBSS)
nodes.description: Waxy gene (Granule-Bound Starch Synthase). Encodes the enzyme responsible for amylose synthesis. Not related to carotenoid biosynthesis.
nodes.description_es: Enzima que produce almidón en los amiloplastos. Es la función principal del endospermo, no parte de la ruta de carotenoides.

metadata.distractor_reason: Starch synthesis is unrelated to carotenoid pathway

nodes.label: Glutelin
nodes.description: Glutelin — the major storage protein of rice endosperm. Not related to carotenoid biosynthesis.
nodes.description_es: Proteína de almacenamiento típica del endospermo del arroz (glutelinas). No está relacionada con la síntesis de carotenoides.

metadata.distractor_reason: Storage proteins are unrelated to carotenoid pathway

winCondition.description: Complete the carotenoid pathway from GGPP to beta-carotene in the endosperm plastid.

steps.label: Gene Transcription
steps.description: The psy and crtI transgenes are transcribed under endosperm-specific promoters. mRNA accumulates in the endosperm cells.
steps.description_es: Los transgenes psy y crtI se leen en el endospermo.

steps.label: Enzyme Production
steps.description: Ribosomes translate the mRNA into PSY and CrtI proteins. Transit peptides direct them to the plastid.
steps.description_es: Los ribosomas fabrican PSY y CrtI, que viajan al plasto.

steps.label: GGPP Pool Active
steps.description: The MEP pathway in the plastid provides GGPP substrate. GGPP levels are sufficient to initiate carotenoid synthesis.
steps.description_es: La ruta MEP del plasto aporta GGPP.

steps.label: Phytoene Synthesis
steps.description: PSY condenses two GGPP molecules into phytoene. The colorless phytoene begins accumulating in the plastid.
steps.description_es: PSY une dos GGPP en fitoeno, que empieza a acumularse.

steps.label: Desaturation Cascade
steps.description: CrtI performs four desaturation steps, converting phytoene through phytofluene, zeta-carotene, and neurosporene to the red lycopene.
steps.description_es: CrtI convierte el fitoeno en licopeno rojo en cuatro pasos.

steps.label: Lycopene Cyclization
steps.description: Endogenous lycopene beta-cyclase (LYC) cyclizes lycopene into beta-carotene. The orange pigment begins to accumulate.
steps.description_es: La LYC del arroz convierte el licopeno en betacaroteno naranja.

steps.label: Golden Grain Phenotype
steps.description: Beta-carotene accumulates in the endosperm, producing the characteristic golden-orange color. The grain contains provitamin A.
steps.description_es: El betacaroteno se acumula y el grano se vuelve dorado.

hints.title: Big picture
hints.content: The carotenoid pathway has three stages: gene expression, enzymatic reactions, and metabolite transformation. Start by connecting each gene to its corresponding enzyme. Remember: genes encode proteins (enzymes), enzymes catalyze reactions, and reactions consume and produce metabolites.
hints.content_es: La ruta tiene tres tramos: genes que fabrican enzimas, enzimas que hacen funcionar reacciones, y reacciones que transforman moléculas. Empieza conectando cada gen con su enzima.

hints.title: Pathway order
hints.content: The pathway flows in this order: GGPP → Phytoene → Lycopene → Beta-Carotene. Three enzymes are needed: PSY (makes phytoene from GGPP), CrtI (makes lycopene from phytoene in 4 steps), and LYC (makes beta-carotene from lycopene). Each enzyme is encoded by its respective gene: psy → PSY, crtI → CrtI, lyc → LYC.
hints.content_es: El orden es GGPP → fitoeno → licopeno → betacaroteno. Hacen falta tres enzimas: PSY (de GGPP a fitoeno), CrtI (de fitoeno a licopeno) y LYC (de licopeno a betacaroteno). Cada una la fabrica su gen: psy → PSY, crtI → CrtI, lyc → LYC.

hints.title: Guided solution
hints.content: Genes: psy–PSY, crtI–CrtI, lyc–LYC. Enzymes: PSY–Phytoene synthesis, CrtI–Phytoene desaturation, LYC–Lycopene cyclization. Reactions: phytoene synthesis uses GGPP and produces phytoene; desaturation uses phytoene and produces lycopene; cyclization uses lycopene and produces beta-carotene. Finally, Beta-carotene–Golden grain.
hints.content_es: Genes: psy–PSY, crtI–CrtI, lyc–LYC. Enzimas: PSY–Síntesis de fitoeno, CrtI–Desaturación del fitoeno, LYC–Ciclación del licopeno. Reacciones: la síntesis de fitoeno usa GGPP y produce fitoeno; la desaturación usa fitoeno y produce licopeno; la ciclación usa licopeno y produce betacaroteno. Por último, Betacaroteno–Grano dorado.

completion.title: Golden grain
completion.summary: You have successfully reconstructed the carotenoid biosynthesis pathway in rice endosperm. By connecting the three key transgenes (psy from daffodil, crtI from bacteria) to their enzymatic machinery, and tracing the metabolic flow from GGPP to beta-carotene, you've modeled the genetic engineering breakthrough of Golden Rice.
completion.realWorldImpact: Vitamin A deficiency affects over 190 million children under 5 worldwide, causing preventable blindness and increased mortality. Golden Rice, which accumulated up to 35 μg beta-carotene per gram in GR2E varieties, could provide a significant portion of daily vitamin A needs for populations that rely on rice as a staple food.
completion.summary_es: Has reconstruido la ruta de los carotenoides en el endospermo del arroz: tres genes (psy del narciso, crtI de una bacteria y lyc del propio arroz) y el recorrido del GGPP hasta el betacaroteno. Es el mismo diseño del Arroz Dorado real.
completion.realWorldImpact_es: La carencia de vitamina A afecta a millones de niños en el mundo y causa ceguera evitable y más mortalidad. El Arroz Dorado GR2E acumula hasta unos 35 µg de betacaroteno por gramo y podría cubrir buena parte de la vitamina A diaria en poblaciones que viven del arroz.

science.organism: Oryza sativa (Golden Rice engineered varieties GR1 and GR2E)
science.realWorldCase: Golden Rice is a real transgenic crop developed to address vitamin A deficiency (VAD) in populations dependent on rice. The first version (GR1) was published in 2000 by Ye et al. in Science. An improved version (GR2E, using only the Narcissus psy gene) was developed and has received food safety approvals in Australia, New Zealand, Canada, and the United States.
science.scientificContext: In wild-type rice endosperm, the carotenoid pathway is blocked at the GGPP → phytoene step because the endosperm does not express phytoene synthase. The MEP pathway is active (producing GGPP for gibberellin biosynthesis), providing the necessary precursor. The crtI gene from Erwinia uredovora (Pantoea ananatis) was chosen because a single bacterial enzyme performs four desaturation steps that require two plant enzymes (PDS and ZDS), simplifying the engineering.
gameplaySimplifications: In reality, the lycopene beta-cyclase used in GR1 was from Narcissus pseudonarcissus; GR2E uses only the endogenous rice OsLCYB. This puzzle uses the endogenous rice lyc gene for simplicity.
The simulation's numerical values (e.g., gene expression percentages) are illustrative gameplay abstractions, not quantitative kinetic models.
The pathway is shown as linear; in reality, there are regulatory feedback loops and competing branch pathways (e.g., xanthophyll synthesis from beta-carotene).
Protein transit peptide targeting and plastid import machinery are not modeled in detail.
The MEP pathway producing GGPP is treated as a fixed substrate pool, not modeled as a separate pathway.

science.realWorldCase_es: El Arroz Dorado es un cultivo transgénico real creado para combatir la carencia de vitamina A. La primera versión (GR1) se publicó en 2000 en Science (Ye et al.). Una versión mejorada (GR2E) ha recibido aprobaciones de seguridad alimentaria en Australia, Nueva Zelanda, Canadá y Estados Unidos.
science.scientificContext_es: En el endospermo del arroz normal la ruta está bloqueada en el paso de GGPP a fitoeno, porque no se expresa la fitoeno sintasa. La ruta MEP sí está activa y aporta el GGPP. Se eligió el gen crtI de Pantoea ananatis porque una sola enzima bacteriana hace las cuatro desaturaciones que en las plantas requieren dos enzimas (PDS y ZDS).
gameplaySimplifications_es: En GR1 la licopeno ciclasa venía del narciso; GR2E usa solo la del propio arroz. El juego usa el gen lyc del arroz para simplificar.
Los valores de la simulación son abstracciones de juego, no un modelo cuantitativo.
La ruta se muestra lineal; en realidad hay regulación y ramas que compiten (por ejemplo, la síntesis de xantofilas a partir del betacaroteno).
No se modela con detalle cómo las enzimas llegan al plasto.
La ruta MEP que produce el GGPP se trata como una reserva fija.

subtitle_es: Provitamina A en el grano de arroz
objective_es: Reconstruye la ruta de los carotenoides en el endospermo del arroz para que produzca betacaroteno (provitamina A).
description_es: El endospermo del arroz no tiene la ruta de los carotenoides. Con genes del narciso (psy) y de una bacteria (crtI) se consiguió que el grano produjera betacaroteno. Conecta los genes, enzimas, reacciones y moléculas correctos para completar la ruta.
